project_info.theme: Toyota July 2026 mega offers across multiple models
project_info.color_palette: Sunset cream, sky blue, orange, deep blue, white

main_subject.detail: A sunset waterfront sales poster with large headline 'UU DAI CUC CHAT Don he cuc vui'. Big offer callouts read 'TANG 1 NAM BAO HIEM THAN VO Danh cho Veloz Cross & Avanza Premio', 'UU DAI LAI SUAT (*) 0%/NAM', and 'HO TRO TUONG DUONG LEN DEN 100% LE PHI TRUOC BA'. At the bottom, four white Toyota models are lined up: Yaris Cross, Veloz Cross, Avanza Premio, and Vios. Bottom text states 'Chuong trinh ap dung cho khach hang mua xe tu ngay 01/07/2026 - 31/07/2026' with a footnote about incentives varying by model. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: High-energy multi-model sales poster with sunset-city backdrop, strong offer hierarchy, and dealership campaign polish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Toyota July 2026 mega offers across multiple models. Centerpiece is a lineup of four white Toyota vehicles by a waterfront skyline at sunset, topped by large offer callouts for 1-year body insurance, 0% annual interest, and support up to 100% registration fee. Background is a warm sunset cityscape with open sky and reflective tiled ground. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'UU DAI CUC CHAT Don he cuc vui', model note 'Danh cho Veloz Cross & Avanza Premio', the date range '01/07/2026 - 31/07/2026', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal multi-model automotive campaign composite, warm sunset commercial lighting, golden glow and glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
